dialogues.text: If I say it once, it’s like saying it a hundred times.
dialogues.source: The News Minute interview with Baasha director Suresh Krissna; English rendering checked against the supplied dialogue reference
dialogues.interpretation: For this moment, take the line as a reminder to let one clear commitment count. It is an original reflection, not part of the film dialogue.
dialogues.originalStory: On Monday, Hari promised himself he would practise for an hour every evening. By Wednesday, the missed hour felt like proof he would never follow through. He changed the promise: ten minutes after dinner, with his phone in another room. That evening, he kept it. The next day he did it again. The smaller promise did not make the goal smaller; it made his word easier to trust. A week later, Hari had more than an hour of practice behind him, built from minutes he could actually keep.
